title: BAGEL: A Benchmark for Assessing Graph Neural Network Explanations
reasoning: The paper includes 'correctness' and 'plausibility' as key evaluation regimes. Correctness aims to detect 'spurious correlations and biases' in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), which directly relates to ethical concerns about model fairness and reliability. Plausibility measures the alignment of the GNN's decision process with 'human rationales' and whether the model predicts 'right for the right reason,' addressing a fundamental ethical aspect of AI interpretability beyond mere accuracy.
